Name: Deadpool Boy
Description: Deadpool Boy debuts canonically in New Champions ( 2025) #2 by Steve Foxe and Ivan Fiorelli. He originally appeared on a variant cover for Deadpool: Badder Blood in October 2023 drawn by Nick Bradshaw. This cover was part of the "New Champions" variants depicting original sidekicks for Marvel's title characters.
